Figure 73, to answer a multiple-choice question simply select from one of the

Figure 74 Matching Pairs 
 
Figure 75 Lesson Complete 
 
Figure 74, the match the pairs question type requires you to press one item on 
the left followed by pressing an item on the right. If you have done this correctly 
both items will light up. If you decide to back track on an option selected, you 
may simply select another item on that column. Once all the pairs have been 
matched the activity will complete. 
Figure 75, once the lesson has finished you will be greeted by a congratulations 
screen. Here your will see stats from your lesson, going from top to bottom, the 
number of gems earned from that lesson, the lengths of time it took you to 
answer all the questions, and how many questions you got correct.
